g.title: j627722954
g.text: PapaPolar: must've been a helluva time, getting used to being here in the past

g.title: j554825020
g.text: You gotta do what you gotta do.

g.title: j2696009176
g.text: Compared to the other things I've had to adjust to in my life? Not really.

g.title: j4268037378
g.text: Kind of? But I've enjoyed it.

g.title: j3689970631
g.text: PapaPolar: song of the soldier, right there. from what i can gather from the rest of the happy lil band 'o freaks, you got sucked into entrati's nonsense same as us.

g.title: j2176957511
g.text: PapaPolar: haha sounds like it, if the crazy stories i've heard from our happy lil band 'o freaks are even half true.

g.title: j1023317024
g.text: PapaPolar: oh yeah? why?

g.title: j570193884
g.text: PapaPolar: if for real different reasons.

g.title: j1237214648
g.text: PapaPolar: still can't wrap my head around how we BOTH got sucked into entrati's nonsense in the end. seems impossible

g.title: j202964503
g.text: I like having a place with walls and windows for a change. And not a ship.

g.title: j3280784993
g.text: The company. It's nice to feel like I belong somewhere for once.

g.title: j400886039
g.text: The food.

g.title: j1186405854
g.text: How'd you wind up getting mixed up with Entrati?

g.title: j2679327940
g.text: I assume you came here looking for Rusalka and found Entrati instead?

g.title: j2821946424
g.text: PapaPolar: yet here we are.

g.title: j2955689550
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah, can't imagine i'd fit well on one of those lil space ships of yours

g.text: PapaPolar: doubt they come me-sized, and i've never been fond of tight spaces.

g.title: j2313496117
g.text: PapaPolar: shit. yeah. family. friends. i've... missed that real hard, lately.

g.title: j3908161500
g.text: PapaPolar: make you some real libertatian BBQ, show you what real food is like. ... no clue where we're gonna get a cow to make brisket out of but we'll cross that bridge when we get there lmao

g.title: j1896134559
g.text: PapaPolar: arrived to this mess somewhere early 1998, so before you arrived. neci refused to see us. couldn't get anywhere NEAR her, even

g.title: j33346861
g.text: PapaPolar: yep. arrived to this mess somewhere early 1998, so before you arrived. neci refused to see us. couldn't get anywhere NEAR her, even

g.title: j1381105192

g.title: j45535701
g.text: PapaPolar: miss sitting around the grill, cooking and laughing, sharing a brewski and a burger.

g.title: j1431424322
g.text: PapaPolar: maybe the techrot makes for good BBQ, what do you think? some of them are pretty meaty

g.title: j641331404

g.title: j1173115334
g.text: PapaPolar: so M and i end up with a shipping container full of the most random shit you can imagine, a buncha bribe money, and heavy weaponry. typical day at the office.

g.title: j4214985669
g.text: PapaPolar: i know an in-joke when i see one. lmao. you bet. happy to oblige

g.title: j4059569419
g.text: PapaPolar: fair 'nuff. eleanor looks pretty brave. i bet she'll try it

g.title: j3885554772
g.text: PapaPolar: who comes knocking on our door, offering us a connection to neci? some rando doktor that makes M *real* nervous.

g.title: j2006009455
g.text: PapaPolar: stay tuned hahaaa

g.title: j1498650404
g.text: PapaPolar: although it may be like eating her second cousin twice removed, i dunno... hm

g.title: j2245448622
g.text: MomToxicated: I have a good instinct for things like this.

g.title: j687945208
g.text: MomToxicated: I hope you realize what you've done.

g.title: j514364260
g.text: PapaPolar: but guess what else we got while we were looking for neci? a bad case of the 'ol testudo syndrome.

g.title: j3212255329
g.text: It's too late to stop him, isn't it?

g.title: j4270022128
g.text: Yeah. Yeah, I think I do.

g.title: j2722464629
g.text: The what?

g.title: j1860132199
g.text: And Entrati had just the injection for it.

g.title: j3899903958
g.text: MomToxicated: Mmhm. Best to just get a beer and watch the chaos unfold.

g.title: j3387378871
g.text: MomToxicated: Best to just get a beer and watch the chaos unfold.

g.title: j4082211545
g.text: MomToxicated: Techrot, darling.

g.title: j706683020
g.text: PapaPolar: yeppers. but he told us what it'd do to us. we knew, eyes open, what it'd do.

g.title: j2537686871
g.text: MomToxicated: But Entrati treated us better than many of the other "protoframes" we've met so far, I will give him that.

g.title: j2571592153
g.text: PapaPolar: what he didn't tell us was that a godsdamned void monster had taken our little girl already

g.title: j1157912874
g.text: MomToxicated: He told us, quite bluntly, what it would do to us. Offered us the choice.

g.title: j3251905974
g.text: MomToxicated: No, he very conveniently left that part out. And by the time we recovered from our... treatment... you had arrived to Höllvania.

g.title: j1603611870
g.text: MomToxicated: And you know how things went from there.

g.title: j2907646461
g.text: Yeah. Front row seat.

g.title: j418843767
g.text: Well... I'm glad you're here.

g.title: j1753867212
g.text: MomToxicated: Always the best.

g.title: j3938303879
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j603302967
g.text: MomToxicated: Glad to hear that. Starting to feel like this is where we're supposed to be, even if... it wasn't for Neci, after all.

g.title: j1588305760
g.text: MomToxicated: But we'll see.
